name: gokul-hub
description: One hub for my mods: a VS Code themed sidebar of operation cards, approval cards, flags, context and plan limits, edit replay and a guard on risky shell commands.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: VS Code look for Claude Code and the hub's cards; off leaves your theme alone.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: Show operations as cards in the hub sidebar, with compact rows in the conversation. Off draws the cards in the conversation.

approvalCards.title: Approval cards
approvalCards.description: Ask for tool approvals with gokul-hub cards (Allow, Deny, More options). Off uses Claude Code's own prompt.
